open_blockers.note: Architect design RED on rev-27. rev-28 remediates these; re-audit pending. These are the ONLY open design blockers.
p0: P0-1 split the renderer from the trusted desktop verifier/broker. rev-27 wrongly folded the trusted Rust/Tauri backend (the final cryptographic verifier + persistence authority) into the untrusted 'client'. rev-28 defines THREE separate identities: Renderer/session UI (interactive login identity, fully untrusted, owns no key/DB/manifest/trust-state, reaches only the broker via a closed command e.g. conversation_id+agent); Trusted desktop verifier/broker (dedicated service UID/SID, separate process, owns the receipt DB + pinned manifest + orchestration + final verification, resolves system/history/config/IDs itself, never accepts renderer-supplied hashes/prepared-objects/verdicts/receipt-fields); Desktop challenge authority (separate dedicated UID/SID, owns the challenge key/store, accepts create-pending/issue only from the broker UID). Broker-compromise scope stated. Renderer denial tests added.

P0-2 make the launcher contract executable + privilege-safe. rev-27 had FD_CLOEXEC on the data FDs 3/4/5/6 (which would close them at fexecve, leaving the executor with no input/output) and an invalid privilege-drop order (setresuid before setgroups/setresgid) with an under-specified capability model. rev-28 locks: data FDs 3-6 FD_CLOEXEC explicitly CLEARED (survive both exec boundaries); executor-image FD O_NOFOLLOW|O_RDONLY|O_CLOEXEC used only by fexecve; the exact syscall sequence (verify -> root cgroup setup -> setgroups([]) -> setresgid(executor) -> drop bounding/ambient caps via CAP_SETPCAP -> setresuid(executor) -> clear all cap sets -> verify unprivileged -> PR_SET_NO_NEW_PRIVS -> fexecve); a setuid-root helper starts fully privileged (not 'only CAP_SETUID/CAP_SETGID'); a real executable integration test + full negative matrix.
p1: P1-1 remove the obsolete 'same-login-user sidecar' wording from the normative §2.1/§2.5 (replace with the 3-actor model: A login user / B renderer-client / C dedicated sidecar SERVICE UID). Historical wording stays only in the non-normative history appendix.
